dataset: data/moonshot/all.csv (COVID Moonshot noncovalent Mpro, pIC50 = 6 - log10(IC50 uM), replicates averaged; 2D, stereochemistry removed)

relative_model.prediction: antisymmetrised pairwise delta, mean over checkpoints

notes: test_test = strict held-out (both members in test); test_train = exploratory (train member's label was used for training both learned models).
Pair-bootstrap CIs treat pairs as independent; pairs share molecules, so CIs are optimistic.
Stereochemistry was removed in data prep: enantiomer cliffs cannot be detected.
